stories.headline: Pentagon email floats suspending Spain from NATO over Iran war stance, triggering transatlantic fallout
stories.summary: Reuters reported on an internal Pentagon email outlining options to punish NATO allies—including suspending Spain—for not supporting US operations in the war with Iran. Spain refused use of its bases and airspace for attacks on Iran. PM Sánchez brushed off the report at the EU Cyprus summit, NATO Secretary-General Rutte offered implicit criticism of US pressure, and European allies at the summit rallied publicly to Spain's defence.

stories.headline: PP-Vox 'prioridad nacional' governance pacts dominate Spanish politics ahead of Andalucía election
stories.summary: Coalition agreements between PP and Vox in Extremadura and Aragón including a 'national priority' clause for Spanish nationals in social aid triggered a week-long political storm. PM Sánchez attacked the pacts as unconstitutional at campaign events across Andalucía ahead of the 17 May regional election; Feijóo defended the agreements while trying to distance himself from their most radical elements; Abascal doubled down, insulting Sánchez ('mierda') and Marlaska ('rata') at rallies in Cádiz, Lucena, and Málaga. The episode also exposed a growing PP-Vox strategic rift. Polls show PP close to absolute majority in Andalucía with Vox stagnant.

stories.headline: King Felipe VI inaugurates CaixaResearch Institute in Barcelona and visits Naval Base Rota amid busy institutional week
stories.summary: Felipe VI had an intensive institutional agenda: he inaugurated Barcelona's CaixaResearch Institute (Spain's first centre dedicated to immunology) alongside Catalan president Salvador Illa; visited Naval Base Rota to inspect the Armada's aviation flotilla and its ongoing transformation; received Portugal's new president Seguro at the Palacio Real with an unusual gesture breaking protocol; and attended a Cervantes Prize lunch for Mexican author Gonzalo Celorio where he acknowledged 'much abuse' during the Conquest. He also participated in an AI and democracy event at La Granja and is confirmed to preside over the Armed Forces Day in Vigo in late May. Pope Francis's upcoming Canary Islands visit will also include Felipe VI.

stories.headline: Kitchen corruption trial: Rajoy, Cospedal testify as CNI's alleged role in Bárcenas spying examined
stories.summary: Former PP prime minister Mariano Rajoy and former party secretary María Dolores de Cospedal appeared before the Audiencia Nacional in the 'Kitchen' case—a suspected state-sponsored operation to spy on PP treasurer Bárcenas. The CNI's alleged involvement, previously denied, came under renewed scrutiny as Soraya Sáenz de Santamaría—who controlled the CNI while in government—was also called as a witness.

stories.headline: Ex-CNI agents testify that PSOE 'fixer' Leire Díez asked them for damaging information on UCO commander
stories.summary: Two former CNI agents testified before a Madrid judge investigating Leire Díez (described as a PSOE political operative or 'fontanera') that she did not identify herself as a journalist in a 2024 meeting and appeared to seek 'dirty laundry' on UCO anti-corruption unit commander Antonio Balas. The case raises questions about whether CNI agents were illegally recorded during the meeting.
